entities.summary: Mikhail Sergeyevich Vorobyev is a Russian professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for SKA Saint Petersburg of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected 104th overall in the 2015 NHL entry draft by the Philadelphia Flyers.
